message.content:
The median (i.e., the middle value) of all residential home prices in California is roughly **$800 000–$850 000** as of early 2024.  
- **Median home value (Zillow, 2024)**: ≈ $825 000  
- **Median price per square foot (Zillow, 2024)**: ≈ $600–$650  

Because the distribution of home prices in California is highly skewed (a few very expensive properties pull the average up), the *average* (mean) price is typically a bit higher—often quoted around **$900 000–$950 000**.  

These figures are based on Zillow’s “Median Home Value” and “Average Price per Square Foot” data for the entire state, aggregated from MLS listings and public records.
